newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intl Specialty started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intl Specialty started.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros analyst Timothy Gerdeman said in a research note that he initiated coverage of International Specialty Products Inc with a strong buy recommendation and a $17 per share, 12-month price target.
-- Shares were up 5/8 to 12-5/8 in late morning New York Stock Exchange trade.

-- "Since ISP was spun off from GAF Corp on January 1 1997, investors can now evaluate ISP on a stand-alone basis, making the company much easier to understand and a more attractive investment mechanism," the analyst said in the note.

-- "Accordingly, it is our belief that ISP will achieve a price/earnings multiple more closely in line with its respective peer group, suggesting meaningful share price appreciation potential," he said.
